name: Overflow Chain
author: fastbit-ljb
description: Adds a new rare relic: Overflow Chain. When your Attack kills an enemy, the excess damage chains to the next enemy - and keeps chaining on every overkill until it runs out or no enemies remain. 新增稀有遗物：溢出链。你的攻击击杀敌人时，溢出的伤害会弹向下一个敌人；若再次击杀并溢出，则继续弹向下一个，直到溢出耗尽或没有敌人。
